narr: Thunderstorms during the afternoon and evening hours on June 2 dumped very heavy rainfall on Lawrence and Cannon Counties, with several reports of flash flooding.
ev: Mt. Lebanon Road in west-central Lawrence County was flooded and impassable.
Shotwell Road west of Lawrenceburg was flooded with adjacent low lying fields covered with water.
Flood waters covered Piney Road near Piney Creek west of Lawrenceburg.
Waterloo Road at Westpoint Road was flooded and impassable.
A portion of North Bradley Road was washed out.
The west end of Spring Creek Road was flooded and impassable due to deep rapidly flowing water from Spring Creek.
Multiple Twitter tSpotter reports indicated several roads were flooded on the southwest side of Woodbury including Hoover Mill Road and Sunny Slope Road.
Twitter tSpotter report indicated Beans Diesel building was flooded on Highway 70. Parts of nearby Hollis Creek Road also flooded with an outbuilding washed 200 yards away.
